   - Run `git diff --name-only` to see modified files

   Based on changes:
   - **Always applicable**: code-reviewer (general quality)

   - Check git status to identify changed files

226	// viewport. It preserves auto-tail: if the viewport was sitting at the bottom
227	// (or has no scrollable content), it jumps to the new bottom after the content
228	// is replaced; otherwise the user's scroll position is left untouched.

231	// idiom of returning an updated tea.Model from Update); the viewport is
232	// mutated in place on the returned copy and the caller assigns the result
233	// back.

238	func (m reviewTUIModel) refreshDetailContentWithAutoTail(wasAtBottom bool) reviewTUIModel {
239		if len(m.rows) == 0 || m.detailIdx < 0 || m.detailIdx >= len(m.rows) {
240			m.detail.SetContent("")

243		lines := buildEventLines(m.rows[m.detailIdx].buffer, m.detailViewportWidth())

251	// handleAgentEvent processes an agentEventMsg, updating the relevant row.
252	func (m reviewTUIModel) handleAgentEvent(msg agentEventMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
253		idx, ok := m.rowIdx[msg.agent]
254		if !ok {
255			return m, nil
256		}
257		row := &m.rows[idx]
258	
259		// Stamp run-start on the first event from this agent (per-row, not
260		// TUI-start; prevents inflated durations for late-starting agents).
261		if row.runStart.IsZero() {
262			row.runStart = time.Now()
263		}
264	
265		row.buffer = append(row.buffer, msg.ev)
266	
267		switch e := msg.ev.(type) {
268		case reviewtypes.Started:
269			// runStart already set; no other state update needed.
270		case reviewtypes.AssistantText:
271			collapsed := stringutil.CollapseWhitespace(sanitizeDisplayText(e.Text))
272			row.preview = truncateDisplayWidth(collapsed, 80)
273		case reviewtypes.Tokens:
274			row.tokens = e // cumulative: overwrite, not sum
275		case reviewtypes.Finished:
276			// RunError is sticky: if a prior RunError event already classified
277			// this row as Failed, a subsequent Finished{Success: true} must NOT
278			// flip it back to Succeeded. CU3's parser-fix-loop guarantees that
279			// RunError + Finished{Success:false} both accompany torn streams;
280			// matching that contract here keeps the TUI consistent with
281			// classifyStatus from CU4 (which honors sawRunError).
282			if row.status != reviewtypes.AgentStatusFailed {
283				if e.Success {
284					row.status = reviewtypes.AgentStatusSucceeded
285				} else {
286					row.status = reviewtypes.AgentStatusFailed
287				}
288			}
289			row.runEnd = time.Now()
290		case reviewtypes.RunError:
291			row.status = reviewtypes.AgentStatusFailed
292			row.err = e.Err
293			if row.runEnd.IsZero() {
294				row.runEnd = time.Now()
295			}
296		case reviewtypes.ToolCall:
297			// No visible state update for tool calls in the dashboard.
298		}
299	
300		// Re-render the focused agent's viewport content when a new event lands
301		// for it. refreshDetailContent's AtBottom check preserves user scroll if
302		// they've scrolled up; auto-tails otherwise.
303		if m.detailMode && m.detailIdx == idx {
304			m = m.refreshDetailContent()
305		}
306	
307		return m, nil
308	}

310	// handleKey processes keyboard input.
311	func (m reviewTUIModel) handleKey(msg tea.KeyPressMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
312		// Post-finish dashboard: only explicit exit keys dismiss. Any other key
313		// (including Ctrl+O) falls through to normal handling so the user can
314		// still drill into completed agent output. Ctrl+C also quits immediately
315		// — there are no agents left to drain.
316		if m.finished && !m.detailMode {
317			if isPostFinishExitKey(msg) || (msg.Code == 'c' && msg.Mod == tea.ModCtrl) {
318				return m, tea.Quit
319			}
320		}
321	
322		switch {
323		case msg.Code == 'c' && msg.Mod == tea.ModCtrl:
324			if m.detailMode {
325				// In drill-in: Ctrl+C is intentionally ignored; Esc first.
326				return m, nil
327			}
328			// Second Ctrl+C while a cancellation is already in flight force-quits
329			// without waiting for agents to drain. The shared CancelFunc is
330			// guarded by cancelOnce, so the second press doesn't double-cancel.
331			if m.cancelling {
332				return m, tea.Quit
333			}
334			m.cancelling = true
335			m.cancelOnce.Do(m.cancel)
336			// Do NOT quit on the first Ctrl+C: leave the TUI up so the user sees
337			// the cancelling indicator while agents drain. Natural finish
338			// (runFinishedMsg) or a second Ctrl+C dismisses the TUI.
339			return m, nil
340	
341		case msg.Code == 'o' && msg.Mod == tea.ModCtrl:
342			if m.detailMode {
343				m.detailMode = false
344				return m, nil
345			}
346			m.detailMode = true
347			if len(m.rows) > 0 && (m.detailIdx < 0 || m.detailIdx >= len(m.rows)) {
348				m.detailIdx = 0
349			}
350			// Resize viewport in case termWidth/termHeight have changed since
351			// last detail-mode entry, then load the focused agent's events and
352			// tail to the bottom.
353			m.detail.SetWidth(m.detailViewportWidth())
354			m.detail.SetHeight(m.detailViewportHeight())
355			m = m.refreshDetailContent()
356			m.detail.GotoBottom()
357			return m, nil
358	
359		case msg.Code == tea.KeyEscape || msg.Code == tea.KeyEsc:
360			if m.detailMode {
361				m.detailMode = false
362				return m, nil
363			}
364			return m, nil
365	
366		case msg.Code == tea.KeyLeft:
367			if m.detailMode && len(m.rows) > 0 {
368				m.detailIdx = (m.detailIdx - 1 + len(m.rows)) % len(m.rows)
369				m = m.refreshDetailContent()
370				m.detail.GotoBottom()
371			}
372			return m, nil
373	
374		case msg.Code == tea.KeyRight:
375			if m.detailMode && len(m.rows) > 0 {
376				m.detailIdx = (m.detailIdx + 1) % len(m.rows)
377				m = m.refreshDetailContent()
378				m.detail.GotoBottom()
379			}
380			return m, nil
381		}
382	
383		// Delegate any unhandled key to the viewport so PgUp/PgDn/Home/End/↑/↓
384		// reach its internal keymap. Only meaningful in detail mode — on the
385		// dashboard the viewport is inert.
386		if m.detailMode {
387			var cmd tea.Cmd
388			m.detail, cmd = m.detail.Update(msg)
389			return m, cmd
390		}
391		return m, nil
392	}
393	
394	// isPostFinishExitKey reports whether msg is one of the explicit exit keys
395	// honored on the post-finish dashboard. Ctrl+C is handled by the caller because
396	// it has a modifier; here we only need q/Esc/Enter without modifiers.
397	func isPostFinishExitKey(msg tea.KeyPressMsg) bool {
398		if msg.Mod != 0 {
399			return false
400		}
401		if msg.Code == tea.KeyEscape || msg.Code == tea.KeyEsc {
402			return true
403		}
404		switch msg.Code {
405		case 'q', tea.KeyEnter:
406			return true
407		}
408		return false
409	}
410	
411	// View renders the current state.
412	//
413	// In detail mode we enable [tea.MouseModeCellMotion] so the embedded
414	// [viewport.Model] receives mouse-wheel events natively — the viewport handles
415	// them as scroll, but only if the Bubble Tea program is configured to deliver
416	// mouse messages. Bubble Tea v2 expresses that config as a per-view field
417	// rather than a Program option, so it lives here next to AltScreen.
418	// Dashboard mode leaves the default [tea.MouseModeNone] in place so normal
419	// terminal mouse selection still works on the summary table.
420	func (m reviewTUIModel) View() tea.View {
421		var content string
422		if m.detailMode && len(m.rows) > 0 {
423			content = detailFrame(m.rows[m.detailIdx], m.detail.View(), m.termWidth, m.termHeight)
424		} else {
425			content = m.dashboardView()
426		}
427		v := tea.NewView(content)
428		v.AltScreen = m.detailMode
429		if m.detailMode {
430			v.MouseMode = tea.MouseModeCellMotion
431		}
432		return v
433	}

435	// dashboardView renders the summary table.
436	func (m reviewTUIModel) dashboardView() string {
437		var b strings.Builder
438	
439		m.writeDashboardLine(&b, m.headerLine())
440	
441		for _, row := range m.rows {
442			m.writeDashboardLine(&b, m.renderRow(row))
443		}
444		b.WriteString("\n")
445	
446		switch {
447		case m.finished:
448			m.writeDashboardLine(&b, m.countsLine())
449			m.writeDashboardLine(&b, "Ctrl+O: drill in · q/Esc/Enter: exit")
450		case m.cancelling:
451			m.writeDashboardLine(&b, "Cancelling agents... · Ctrl+C again: force quit")
452		default:
453			m.writeDashboardLine(&b, "Ctrl+O: drill in · Ctrl+C: cancel")
454		}
455		return b.String()
456	}

458	func (m reviewTUIModel) writeDashboardLine(b *strings.Builder, line string) {
459		b.WriteString(truncateDisplayWidth(line, m.dashboardWidth()))
460		b.WriteString("\n")
461	}

463	func (m reviewTUIModel) dashboardWidth() int {
464		if m.termWidth <= 0 {
465			return 80
466		}
467		return m.termWidth
468	}

470	// headerLine returns the column header row.
471	func (m reviewTUIModel) headerLine() string {
472		return m.renderTableLine("AGENT", "STATUS", "DURATION", "TOKENS", "PREVIEW")
473	}
474	
475	// renderRow renders one agent row.
476	func (m reviewTUIModel) renderRow(row agentRow) string {
477		name := row.name
478	
479		var statusStr string
480		switch row.status {
481		case reviewtypes.AgentStatusSucceeded:
482			statusStr = "✓ done"
483		case reviewtypes.AgentStatusFailed:
484			statusStr = "✗ failed"
485		case reviewtypes.AgentStatusCancelled:
486			statusStr = "— cancel"
487		case reviewtypes.AgentStatusUnknown:
488			switch {
489			case m.cancelling:
490				// In-flight cancellation: distinct from the terminal Cancelled
491				// state ("— cancel") so the user can see that the cancel signal
492				// has been sent but the agent is still draining.
493				statusStr = "cancelling"
494			case row.runStart.IsZero():
495				statusStr = "queued"
496			default:
497				statusStr = m.spinner.View() + " running"
498			}
499		}
500	
501		durStr := ""
502		if !row.runStart.IsZero() {
503			if !row.runEnd.IsZero() {
504				durStr = formatDuration(row.runEnd.Sub(row.runStart))
505			} else {
506				durStr = formatDuration(time.Since(row.runStart))
507			}
508		}
509	
510		tokStr := ""
511		if row.tokens.In > 0 || row.tokens.Out > 0 {
512			tokStr = fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s", formatCompact(row.tokens.In), formatCompact(row.tokens.Out))
513		}
514	
515		return m.renderTableLine(name, statusStr, durStr, tokStr, row.preview)
516	}

518	func (m reviewTUIModel) renderTableLine(agent, status, duration, tokens, preview string) string {
519		const (
520			agentWidth    = 20
521			statusWidth   = 10
522			durationWidth = 8
523			tokensWidth   = 8
524			minWidth      = agentWidth + statusWidth + durationWidth + tokensWidth + 8 // four two-space separators
525		)
526		termWidth := m.dashboardWidth()
527	
528		previewWidth := termWidth - minWidth
529		if previewWidth < 0 {
530			previewWidth = 0
531		}
532	
533		line := fmt.Sprintf("%s  %s  %s  %s  %s",
534			padDisplayWidth(agent, agentWidth),
535			padDisplayWidth(status, statusWidth),
536			padDisplayWidth(duration, durationWidth),
537			padDisplayWidth(tokens, tokensWidth),
538			truncateDisplayWidth(preview, previewWidth))
539		return truncateDisplayWidth(line, termWidth)
540	}
541	
542	// countsLine produces the summary line shown after the run finishes.
543	func (m reviewTUIModel) countsLine() string {
544		succ, fail, canc := 0, 0, 0
545		for _, r := range m.summary.AgentRuns {
546			switch r.Status {
547			case reviewtypes.AgentStatusSucceeded:
548				succ++
549			case reviewtypes.AgentStatusFailed:
550				fail++
551			case reviewtypes.AgentStatusCancelled:
552				canc++
553			case reviewtypes.AgentStatusUnknown:
554				// not counted
555			}
556		}
557		return fmt.Sprintf("%d agent(s) done — %d succeeded, %d failed, %d cancelled",
558			len(m.summary.AgentRuns), succ, fail, canc)
559	}

561	// formatDuration formats a duration compactly for the table column.
562	func formatDuration(d time.Duration) string {
563		if d < time.Second {
564			return fmt.Sprintf("%dms", d.Milliseconds())
565		}
566		if d < time.Minute {
567			return fmt.Sprintf("%.1fs", d.Seconds())
568		}
569		return fmt.Sprintf("%dm%ds", int(d.Minutes()), int(d.Seconds())%60)
570	}
571	
572	// formatCompact formats a token count as e.g. "1.2k" or "450".
573	func formatCompact(n int) string {
574		if n >= 1000 {
575			return fmt.Sprintf("%.1fk", float64(n)/1000)
576		}
577		return strconv.Itoa(n)
578	}
